CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $120,000 - $175,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

About CirrusMD:

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at cirrusmd.com .

About the role

There’s data everywhere. The real value comes from knowing what it means, what matters, and what we should do next.

That’s where you come in.

As a Lead Business Intelligence Analyst at CirrusMD, you’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, healthcare, and business strategy. You’ll partner with teams across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering to turn complex questions into trusted data, meaningful insights, and better decisions.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply take requests and build dashboards.

You’ll help shape how CirrusMD measures success, demonstrates the value of our solutions, and builds a stronger data-informed culture. You’ll be comfortable talking strategy with business leaders one minute and getting into SQL, LookML, data models, or reporting logic the next.

If you love digging into complex data, connecting dots others might miss, and turning analysis into action, we’d love to meet you.

Location: This position can work remotely from anywhere within the U.S.

What you'll do (Essential Responsibilities)

Connect data to the business. Serve as a trusted data partner across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering, helping teams connect business goals with technical execution.

Show the value. Build measurement frameworks that translate our product, clinical, and commercial work into meaningful performance metrics and help demonstrate the value and ROI of CirrusMD’s solutions.

Own the data journey. Lead analytics projects from the first question and feasibility assessment through modeling, analysis, reporting, and client-facing delivery.

Build data people can trust. Partner with Engineering to define data structures and strengthen our Looker semantic layer, creating scalable, reusable, high-confidence data.

Turn complexity into clarity. Dig into complex datasets and uncover insights that help teams understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where we should go next.

Bring performance to life. Build thoughtful dashboards, visualizations, and reporting frameworks that make important metrics understandable and actionable.

Protect the integrity of the data. Balance client and stakeholder needs with strong governance, privacy standards, and organizational data practices.

Get into the weeds when it matters. Investigate anomalies, challenge assumptions, validate results, and make sure the story the data tells is actually true.

Help us get smarter. Identify opportunities to evolve our analytics capabilities, improve existing data models, reduce technical debt, and make trusted insights easier to access across the organization.

Take on other responsibilities as needed to support our clients, teams, and business.

What you'll bring (Qualifications)

Experience: 5+ years of relevant analytics or business intelligence experience.

Strong to advanced SQL skills and experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.

Hands-on experience with business intelligence platforms such as Looker.

Experience building and maintaining semantic layers using LookML.

Experience using GitHub or similar version-control practices within a modern analytics environment.

A track record of translating complex or ambiguous business questions into well-defined technical and analytical solutions.

Experience owning analytics work from initial idea through feasibility, modeling, validation, visualization, and delivery.

The ability to build new data solutions while also improving, refactoring, and simplifying existing ones.

Strong two-way communication skills that allow you to explain technical concepts to business partners and translate business needs for technical teams.

Experience balancing complex, client-facing data requests with established data governance standards.

Experience working with high-integrity data processes where accuracy is non-negotiable, such as billing, invoicing, financial, or clinical reporting.

Knowledge and application of analytical and statistical concepts such as confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, sentiment analysis, and anomaly detection.

The ability to manage competing priorities and know when a problem requires a deep dive and when it’s time to zoom back out.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modern data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt or Airflow.

Experience using Python or R when the analysis needs to go beyond SQL.

Knowledge of healthcare data and standards, including HIPAA, FedRAMP, PII/PHI, or clinical quality measures such as HEDIS, NCQA, or NQF.

Experience with event-based product analytics or Customer Data Platforms such as Segment.

A strong understanding of modern data architecture and how upstream engineering decisions affect downstream analytics.

Experience working within digital health or the broader U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

Experience using AI to make data easier to access and understand, including natural-language querying, conversational analytics, or AI-enabled self-service BI.

What's in it for you:

CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including:

Competitive compensation

Deeply subsidized medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family

Unlimited PTO / Vacation

401(K) + match

Design, maintain, and distribute customer-facing and internal dashboards that track GPO and membership key performance indicators. As an integral member of the Analytics Team, the Specialized Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is responsible for creating information-based, business intelligence deliverables that will be relied upon by organizational leaders to support critical business decisions. The Specialized BI Analyst will provide domain expertise in one or more specific areas, as required for the position, such as: clinical, consumer experience, finance, human resources, marketing, medical insurance, operational effectiveness and/or supply chain. This position will primarily work, but not exclusively, with customers across the organization in clinical, administrative and/or operational areas to provide analytical insights from reports and/or dashboard visualizations to facilitate discovery of new opportunities, support data-informed decision-making for identified challenges as well as develop new and enhance existing metrics to analyze ongoing performance metrics.  
  
The Specialized BI Analyst will be tasked with domain-specific requests to support transformation of data and information into actionable insights that answer complex business questions. This position will communicate insights and opportunities to leadership, analytical needs to technical teams, as well as serve as a domain expert and mentor to other team members supporting projects that are outside their specialized domain. This position will work with customers to understand and define the problems being solved, procure and integrate the data sources necessary to analyze the needs appropriately, deliver appropriate relevant tools to meet customer’s objectives, implement and support the solutions for ongoing utilization.

## **Job Description**

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**:  Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, management information systems, data science, business administration, statistics, or related field or equivalent experience required.  Master’s degree preferred.

  

**Licenses/Certifications**: Associate Certified Analytics Professional (aCAP) or another vendor-neutral analytics certification preferred.  Applicable certification or accreditation for domain expertise preferred.

  

**Experience / Knowledge / Skills:**

* Minimum of 2 years professional experience providing similar analytics services for this role to one or more domain areas, as needed preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years professional experience collaborating with customers on the design, creation and execution of analytics deliverables preferred.
* Minimum of 2 years professional experience in building self-service analytic reports, dashboards and/or tools supporting decision-making and actionable metric monitoring by customers preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working in a dynamic, matrixed organization with executive exposure.
* Basic proficiency with the following tools, as necessary for position:

    * Database querying: SQL
    * Visualization tools – Tableau (preferred), Sisense, Qlik or Microsoft PowerBI
    * Statistical tools - R, Python, SAS, SPSS or other statistical tools for data analysis. (Preferred)
* Demonstrated critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills and ability to exert influence without authority through interpreting requirements and guiding customers to the desired analytics outcomes.
* Analytic mindset able to draw conclusions from raw data and summarize results efficiently using logic and reasoning to identify approaches to problems.
* Ability to visualize data in a meaningful way to communicate effectively the meaning and the necessary action to be taken.
* Act with an intellectual curiosity to obtain insights from data and search for solutions to the problems being explored as well as new ones to be discovered.
* Understand math and statistical concepts to provide analysis to formulate meaningful decisions.
* Exceptional time management skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, specifically with an ability to communicate effectively across multiple management levels.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team under established deadlines to drive critical outcomes.
* Create a positive work environment that fosters successful team performance.
* Strong customer service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

  
  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* Develops, prioritizes and executes projects according to established schedules and timeframes.
* Follows and enforces technical and documentations standards
* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge and techniques in supporting other systems and application programmers in projects and complex problem solving efforts.
* Use scripting tools & ServiceNow functionality to create scripts and automate tasks
* Build Quality Assurance Scripts for Patch and Upgrade testing
* Perform regular data audits and resolve identified issues
* Maintain and support ServiceNow operational functions
* Escalate to vendor and involve them in defect and incident resolution as required
* Stay current on technologies that are required for this development.
* Participate in Agile Scrum process that is leveraged as the teams SDLC.
* Develop and implement enterprise IT tools to support an IT managed service delivery approach.
* Focus on continual service improvement to increase efficiency and cost optimization of services, and IT service delivery processes.
* Develop, define, and document systems management policies, processes, procedures, and drive implementation and use within the program.
* Perform user administration on enterprise management supporting technologies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Further network assist by identifying reasonable evidence for failures to prevent reoccurrence.
* Manage data generated by the IT enterprise tools that generate tickets assigned to engineers for resolution and document IT issues for root cause analysis and lessons learned.
* Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.
* Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.
* Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has been recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Employers for Company Culture.

Benefits Overview

UT Health San Antonio offers an excellent benefits package for its employees. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week, with an appointment of at least 4.5 months, are eligible for benefits.

Medical - UT SELECT Medical insurance is offered free for employees and administered by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. Family members can be added to the plan through payroll deduction. Employees and their dependents can also receive discounted copays and coinsurance when using UT Health Physicians, a network of 800 premier physicians including more than 100 specialists. Employees receive $50,000 of group term life insurance and $50,000 of basic accidental death and dismemberment insurance for free, with options to purchase additional employee and dependent coverage for both at group rates.

Dental - Three dental insurance plan options are available for employees and their families through Delta Dental Insurance Company, two PPOs and one dental HMO plan. Both PPO plans allow employees to choose any licensed dentist.

Vision - Fully insured Vision Care benefits are offered by Superior Vision Services. Two vision plan options that offer either standard or enhanced vision benefits.

Disability - Employees can enroll in the Disability Insurance which provides income if a non-work related illness or injury prevents you from working.

FSAs - Employees can enroll in flexible spending accounts (FSAs) to set aside money from earnings before taxes for qualifying dependent day care expenses or out-of-pocket health care expenses.

Retirement - Employees are eligible for either the Teacher Retirement System (TRS) or the Optional Retirement Plan (ORP).
